title: Senior Curriculum Engineer
searchText: Senior Curriculum Engineer MongoDB As a Senior Curriculum Engineer, you'll work with a team of creative educators and software engineers dedicated to building the future of online technical education, developing courses for MongoDB University . MongoDB University is the online training department of MongoDB and is chartered with building high quality training at a basic and advanced level across the entire MongoDB product stack. The University team is focused on creating skill-based learning content , designed to equip enterprise users and a general audience with the core skills needed to successfully use MongoDB. Your work will directly impact the learning experience of millions of developers around the world, helping them become experts in the field by honing their skills on the fastest growing modern database. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model. What You’ll Do You’ll work closely with a team of curriculum engineers, curriculum designers, and in-house subject-matter experts to build course materials focused on upskilling our employees and supporting new hire onboarding. You'll write learning video scripts, design hands-on labs, and deliver content, ensuring these MongoDB learning resources are relevant, interactive, and reflect the challenges our teams encounter in the real world. In this role, we expect you to continually grow your knowledge of MongoDB and become an expert who knows a subset of MongoDB offerings in depth. You will articulate the key concepts and skills that need to be covered in a training course, write course materials for an internal technical audience, design the hands-on exercises and also support the creation of skill badges that assess a learner's knowledge. If you are a current Developer or a current Administrator of MongoDB, you will be able to add a lot of value to the team as we strive for our training to be from experts who already use our products. If you currently provide technical assistance or consulting for MongoDB solutions, you will also be able to add value to this team. If you are new to MongoDB, you'll be expected to learn MongoDB products quickly and articulate how they work. In this team, you will also get access to experts throughout the company and stay cutting edge on your technical skills and expertise. MongoDB continues to evolve and you will have the opportunity to explore new technology areas that will end up being represented as training offerings to support MongoDB teams. Your core responsibilities and duties will include the following Ideate and write skill-based course materials and videos Create code and visualizations to demonstrate technical concepts as you teach MongoDB Develop hands-on lab exercises to help learners experience MongoDB technologies Collaborate with in-house subject-matter experts, curriculum designers, video producers, product and enablement stakeholders to develop a course from discovery to launch Deliver instructor-led internal training such as onboarding sessions and in-house bootcamps when needed Use AI-assisted content generation tooling to accelerate first outlines and updates, while ensuring human-in-the-loop quality review and curriculum governance Become an expert on part of the MongoDB product set to help drive content strategy and direction along with our Product Strategy and Curriculum team Continually expand your domain knowledge of MongoDB, software development, and learning sciences What You’ll Need You’re a good fit for this role if you have a demonstrable track record in working with MongoDB or similar technologies already as a developer, DBA or some other capacity with a minimum of 3-5 years industry experience. Your track record is more important than a Computer Science or similar degree. You should have writing and/or instructional experience that demonstrates an ability to communicate complex technical concepts for a general audience. We expect you to be able to review content and code. As a Curriculum Engineer, we are counting on your experience to translate technical concepts to help others learn MongoDB. What this is not A development role. Some prototyping is required however the emphasis is on content development, instruction, and subject matter expertise. You’ll be successful in this role if your qualifications and skills match the following Proven track record in working with databases, MongoDB or NoSQL experience preferred Experience writing and/or teaching instructional content (internal enablement or external training background is fine if you can pivot to internal outcomes) Proficiency in at least one contemporary programming language (Python, Node.js, Java, etc.) Basic knowledge of Linux Some cloud experience (AWS preferred) A passion for education and learning About MongoDB MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform, the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and over 60,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world! MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
